title: (fix) O3-6046: Return null when height is outside reference table or no reference applies
body:

## Summary

`calcWeightForHeightZscore` was returning `'-4'` whenever the height was below 45 cm or above 110 cm, which falsely indicated severe wasting when it only meant the WHO reference table had no row for that height. Additionally, children aged 5 and over (who have no weight-for-height reference) who are taller than 110 cm were also getting `'-4'`.

This PR updates `calcWeightForHeightZscore` in `CommonExpressionHelpers` to:
- Return `null` when `weightForHeightRef` is missing/null (e.g. child aged 5 and over).
- Return `null` when the height is outside the reference table (< 45 cm or > 110 cm), rather than `'-4'`.
- Update the unit tests and add coverage for children aged >= 5 taller than 110 cm.
